title: vLEI External Association v1
description: An untargeted credential issued by a Legal Entity to associate its AID with an external identifier.

v.description: ACDC version, JSON serialization format, and serialized credential byte count.

d.description: BLAKE3-256 SAID of the complete association credential.

u.description: Issuer-scoped nonce of 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, signed unchanged and consumed by the verifier at association acceptance.

i.description: AID of the issuing Legal Entity that holds the referenced LE vLEI credential.

ri.description: SAID of the issuer's credential registry tracking issuance and revocation.

a.description: Association attributes containing the external identifier and its signed proof.

d.description: BLAKE3-256 SAID of the association attributes.

extId.description: External identifier associated with the Legal Entity AID; its profile defines the canonical form.

proof.description: External signature collected before issuance, binding the issuer AID, LE vLEI SAID, external identifier, and nonce.

d.description: BLAKE3-256 SAID of this proof block, covering alg, tag, and sig.

alg.description: Identifies the signature scheme and cryptographic algorithm used for the external proof.

tag.description: Domain-separation tag identifying the association protocol and version.

sig.description: External signature over the association challenge, encoded as defined by the identifier profile and signature scheme.

dt.description: Optional issuer-declared timestamp in KERI UTC format with microseconds; TEL evidence supplies authenticated issuance time.

e.description: Credential edges linking the association to the Legal Entity's LE vLEI.

d.description: BLAKE3-256 SAID of the credential edges.

le.description: Reference to the LE vLEI credential held by the association issuer.

n.description: SAID of the referenced LE vLEI credential, also signed in the external challenge.

s.description: SAID of the LE vLEI credential schema.

o.description: I2I edge operator requiring the association issuer to equal the LE vLEI issuee.
